svg.aria-label: A library. Loading: branches hold the book, a catalogue picks the first branch listed, a plan measures each reading room and gives it volumes, porters copy them, and an image model stays unpacked on a cart in the hall. Experts: a reader asks the router, manuals on the shelf are read at the desk, a missing one is photocopied onto a tray or read in the archives, the answers fill a jar by weight, and a librarian copies a hot manual onto the coldest place.
